propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) is currently only a prose sketch and lacks concrete backend interface specification needed for Phase 2 implementation stories S2–S5
The backend interface must pin four design decisions: rebar as canonical model, core owns diff/apply, role Protocols behind Backend facade, and RemoteRef as identity tuple

The ADR must define role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and optional capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) with a Backend facade and registry keyed on config.reconciler.backend
Three leak-fixes must be documented: ADF-sizing removed from differ, lossy-status/parent rules moved to Jira adapter, duplicated value-maps/link-constants consolidated
The revision must update Status, Decisions 5–6, and Consequences to reference the pinned design and scope the first real second backend to epic be74
